result: In deep linear networks with squared loss, every local minimum is global and every other critical point is a saddle — but from two hidden layers on, some saddles are flat (no negative Hessian eigenvalue).
result_plain: Deep linear nets: every local minimum is global; deeper nets have flat (bad) saddles.
toy: (1 - w1 w2)^2 and (1 - w1 w2^2)^2, the losses of scalar linear chains
